mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_dataset (id, vm_id, name, description, data_type, status, metadata) VALUES (#{id}, #{vmId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{dataType}, #{status}, CAST(#{metadata} AS JSON)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vm_id = VALUES(vm_id), name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), data_type = VALUES(data_type), status = VALUES(status), metadata = VALUES(metadata)
mapper.update: UPDATE training_dataset SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE training_dataset SET description = #{description}, tags = #{tags}, metadata = #{metadata}, update_time = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE training_dataset SET progress = #{progress}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE training_dataset SET is_valid = #{isValid}, validation_time = NOW(), validation_result = #{validationResult}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE training_dataset SET is_processed = #{isProcessed}, process_time = NOW(), process_result = #{processResult}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, vm_id, name, description, data_type, status, metadata, upload_time FROM training_dataset WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT data_type as dataType, COUNT(*) as count FROM training_dataset GROUP BY data_type
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM training_dataset GROUP BY status
SELECT vm_id as vmId, COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) as size FROM training_dataset GROUP BY vm_id
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM training_dataset WHERE upload_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(upload_time) ORDER BY DATE(upload_time) DESC LIMIT 7
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM training_dataset WHERE upload_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(upload_time) ORDER BY DATE(upload_time) DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT data_type as dataType, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_dataset), 1) as percentage FROM training_dataset GROUP BY data_type ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
